name: Create an empty automation
description: Create a new empty automation (workflow) in draft/inactive state. It has no trigger yet. Use as the first step of building an automation; then add a trigger with automations.add_trigger. The public API has no automation endpoints.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Created 'Automation #1' via 'Create from scratch'. Observed on the test account: a banner says it is suspended for marketing emails, so activating a workflow that sends email is expected to be blocked. Not tested.

side_effects: Creates an inactive workflow named 'Automation #<n>' (the UI ignores workflow_name and numbers it).
